# Fabrication and errors in the bibliographic citations generated by ChatGPT (Walters & Wilder, 2023)

A test note for `verify_quotes.py`. Its source text is the one this repository keeps for the real note. The first
two quotes are in the paper as written. The third has one digit changed (65% for 55%), and the fourth is a real
quote given with the wrong page.

- **Source:** Scientific Reports 13: 14045 (pages = PDF pages)
- **File:** `../../../research/papers/walters-2023-fabrication-errors-chatgpt-citations.pdf`

## Quotes
- "55% of the GPT-3.5 citations but just 18% of the GPT-4 citations are fabricated" (p. 1)
- "ChatGPT is fundamentally not an information-processing tool, but a language-processing tool" (p. 1)
- "65% of the GPT-3.5 citations but just 18% of the GPT-4 citations are fabricated" (p. 1)
- "ChatGPT is fundamentally not an information-processing tool, but a language-processing tool" (p. 4)
